description: This file defines the ConsumerEventCountingGrain class, an Orleans grain implementation that subscribes to a stream, counts received items, and handles activation and deactivation lifecycle events.

classes.name: ConsumerEventCountingGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that subscribes to an event stream, counts incoming items, and manages its subscription lifecycle.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, initializes counters and subscription handle.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, stops consumption and resets counters.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes to a specified stream provider and stream ID, setting up the observer.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the stream if currently subscribed.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of items consumed so far.

methods.name: AsyncObserver<T>
methods.description: Nested class implementing IAsyncObserver to process stream items asynchronously.

methods.name: EventArrived
methods.description: Handles incoming stream events, increments count, and logs.
